As our Trauma Coordinator RN, you will directly support Trauma Services and enhance patient care, elevating trauma expertise and leading injury prevention efforts aligned with our mission.

For Level III centers, you'll coordinate the entire trauma program, including safety and performance improvement. Your focus will be on maintaining quality, community education, and strengthening regional ties.

Develops and reviews policies, procedures and protocols in relation to the care of trauma patients to ensure compliance with applicable standards and requirements.
Consults with trauma care practitioners in the care of trauma patients; participates in problem-solving processes to address and resolve related issues.

Required

We are proud of our pioneering medical advances and numerous awards and accreditations that reflect our dedication to excellence. jobs.title: Readiness Data Analyst – Systems Analyst II
jobs.description:
Overview

VTG is seeking Readiness Data Analyst – Systems Analyst II (PMA-275)
to provide product support and in-service logistics support to the NAVAIR PMA-275 Joint Program Office. Specifically, provide sustainment data analytics support to the V-22 Osprey Sustainment Readiness Lead at PMA-275 Program Office, Patuxent River, MD.

What will you do?

Possesses demonstrated Critical Thinking skills along with a fundamental knowledge of the application of statistical analysis.
Capability of using the majority of Naval Aviation Enterprise (NAE) developed tools and reports to monitor and analyze Readiness levels for the various Type/Model/Series and their associated Mission Sets.
Demonstrate skills and understanding with DECKPLATE, NAMP, One Touch, NATEC, and other software tools necessary to properly gather, review and analyze data impacting the V-22 platform performance to established Enterprise standards.
Provide Program Managers and all stakeholders analysis of significant events and trend movement away from established readiness and cost goals in written, oral of brief formats.
Implement and facilitate inter-program interfaces throughout the NAE.
Represents V-22 Readiness in NAE Readiness Working Groups, Product Support Working Groups, Logistics Products and Process Reviews, and Maintenance Working Groups in support of Sustainment IPT.
Respond to data calls from leadership, schedule meetings as necessary and provide leadership ressults in a written, oral or brief format as requested.
The Data Analyst is responsible for the delivery of the following Data Driven Products as needed:
Analysis
Forecasts
Data Products
Performance Monitoring
Knowledge Management System entries
Ability to validate the data points and verify the accuracy of the data collection.
Support the Readiness Lead in providing:

Recommended Product Support Strategy (PSS), Maintenance Concept and Product Support Package (PSP) Updates
Data integration, analysis focused on accurate and effective decision making.
Prepare and/or deliver oral or brief type presentations, along with associated written analyses to customers/stakeholders in order to address readiness issues to justify logistics requirements/implementation.

Do you have what it takes?

Education: BS or BA degree.
Allowable Substitution: An additional five (5) years of acquisition or logistics management experience may be substituted for a BS or BA degree.
Experience - At least five (5) years of experience in operational logistics support or in-service sustainment of weapon system platforms. Experience must include: Four (4) years in the performance of comprehensive analysis across the spectrum of Product Support elements during a job assignment in or in support of an acquisition command/operational command weapon system.
Allowable Substitution: An MS or MA degree can be substituted for two (2) years operations logistics experience.
Work hours will be in direct support of the client; therefore, hours may be fluid at times in order to meet customer/operational requirements. Work schedule flexibility is required. Possible telework opportunities exist per NAVAIR guidance.
Possesses demonstrated Critical Thinking skills along with a fundamental knowledge of the application of statistical analysis.
Capability of using the majority of Naval Aviation Enterprise (NAE) developed tools and reports to monitor and analyze Readiness levels for the various Type/Model/Series and their associated Mission Sets.
Demonstrate skills and understanding with DECKPLATE, NAMP, One Touch, NATEC, and other software tools necessary to properly gather, review and analyze data impacting the V-22 platform performance to established Enterprise standards.

Desirable Skills/Abilities

Highly proficient with the Microsoft Professional Office Suite including Microsoft Word, Access, Excel, Power Point, and Project; well developed written and oral communication skills; ability to assess established maintenance/business processes, identify/document maintenance/business process problems and recommend maintenance/business process improvement initiatives; strong team building skills and ability to develop and maintain a highly integrated network of team members required to successfully execute the PMA-207 mission.
Knowledge of the following areas is highly desirable:
a) Life Cycle Sustainment Planning, roles and responsibilities;
b) Product Support / Integrated Logistics Support Requirements;
c) Navy / Marine Corps / Air Force Command Mission Requirements;
d) NAVAIR Sustainment Group Charter and Goals;
e) In-service sustainment activity roles and responsibilities and
f) Data analytics and Tableau software.

Pay Range: VTG’s estimated starting pay range is $100,000-$160,000 annually which is a general guideline for the geographic location. When extending an offer, VTG also considers work experience, education, skill level, market considerations and may possibly include contractual requirements which may cause an offer to fall outside of this range.

The Data Analyst will serve as a key analytical partner between Information Technology and Customer Service, with a primary focus on data and processes within Toho’s Customer Information System (CIS). This position will use reporting and data analysis to identify errors, uncover trends, evaluate business processes, and highlight opportunities to improve efficiency and system utilization.

This role goes beyond simply running reports. The Data Analyst will dig into the data to understand what is happening, identify why issues are occurring, and work collaboratively with Customer Service and Information Technology teams to develop practical solutions. From identifying recurring data or processing errors to evaluating workflows and finding opportunities for automation or process improvement, this position will help turn CIS data into actionable information that strengthens day-to-day operations.

Essential Functions

Collects, analyzes, and interprets data from multiple organizational systems and sources to identify trends, patterns, relationships, and opportunities for improvement.
Develops and maintains dashboards, reports, scorecards, and other analytical tools that provide leaders and departments with timely and meaningful performance information.
Partners with departments to understand business processes, operational challenges, reporting needs, and key performance indicators and translates those needs into effective data solutions.
Analyzes operational and organizational performance data to identify emerging trends, performance gaps, risks, efficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.
Translates complex datasets and analytical findings into clear, concise, and actionable information for technical and non-technical audiences.
Supports the development, monitoring, and reporting of organizational key performance indicators, strategic plan measures, departmental metrics, and other performance measures.
Integrates and evaluates information from multiple systems and datasets to provide a more comprehensive view of organizational performance.
Develops recurring and ad hoc reports to support operational decisions, executive leadership, strategic initiatives, Board reporting, and other organizational needs.
Identifies opportunities to improve or automate existing reporting processes, reduce manual data collection, and increase access to reliable information.
Evaluates data quality and works with appropriate departments and system owners to identify and resolve inconsistencies, gaps, duplication, and other data integrity concerns.
Assists with establishing and maintaining organizational standards for data definitions, reporting methodologies, documentation, and data governance.
Performs quantitative and qualitative analysis to support business cases, organizational initiatives, resource planning, process improvements, and operational decision-making.
Develops visualizations and presentations that effectively communicate analytical findings, trends, and recommendations to leadership and other stakeholders.

Supports departments in identifying meaningful performance measures and developing methods to effectively collect, analyze, and monitor those measures.

Documents analytical methodologies, data sources, calculations, assumptions, business rules, and reporting processes to promote consistency and continuity.
Provides guidance and support to employees and leaders in interpreting dashboards, reports, metrics, and analytical findings.
Maintains current knowledge of data analytics, visualization, business intelligence, and reporting technologies and recommends tools or practices that may improve organizational capabilities.

Founded in 1988, Marketech International Corp. (MIC) is a global technology and engineering company supporting semiconductor, high-tech manufacturing, and mission-critical facility projects. Marketech International Corporation USA is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Data Analyst - Supply Chain & Operations to support data-driven decision-making across supply chain, procurement, project management, and operational functions.

This position is responsible for collecting, organizing, validating, analyzing, and presenting business and operational data from multiple sources. The Data Analyst will develop reports and dashboards, monitor key performance indicators, identify trends and discrepancies, and translate complex information into clear and actionable insights for management and cross-functional teams.

The ideal candidate is a quick learner with strong analytical and communication skills, advanced Microsoft Excel capabilities, and experience working with supply chain or operational data. new_jobs.description:
Overview

VTG is seeking Readiness Data Analyst – Systems Analyst II (PMA-275)
to provide product support and in-service logistics support to the NAVAIR PMA-275 Joint Program Office. Specifically, provide sustainment data analytics support to the V-22 Osprey Sustainment Readiness Lead at PMA-275 Program Office, Patuxent River, MD.

What will you do?

Possesses demonstrated Critical Thinking skills along with a fundamental knowledge of the application of statistical analysis.
Capability of using the majority of Naval Aviation Enterprise (NAE) developed tools and reports to monitor and analyze Readiness levels for the various Type/Model/Series and their associated Mission Sets.
Demonstrate skills and understanding with DECKPLATE, NAMP, One Touch, NATEC, and other software tools necessary to properly gather, review and analyze data impacting the V-22 platform performance to established Enterprise standards.
Provide Program Managers and all stakeholders analysis of significant events and trend movement away from established readiness and cost goals in written, oral of brief formats.
Implement and facilitate inter-program interfaces throughout the NAE.
Represents V-22 Readiness in NAE Readiness Working Groups, Product Support Working Groups, Logistics Products and Process Reviews, and Maintenance Working Groups in support of Sustainment IPT.
Respond to data calls from leadership, schedule meetings as necessary and provide leadership ressults in a written, oral or brief format as requested.
The Data Analyst is responsible for the delivery of the following Data Driven Products as needed:
Analysis
Forecasts
Data Products
Performance Monitoring
Knowledge Management System entries
Ability to validate the data points and verify the accuracy of the data collection.
Support the Readiness Lead in providing:

Recommended Product Support Strategy (PSS), Maintenance Concept and Product Support Package (PSP) Updates
Data integration, analysis focused on accurate and effective decision making.
Prepare and/or deliver oral or brief type presentations, along with associated written analyses to customers/stakeholders in order to address readiness issues to justify logistics requirements/implementation.

Do you have what it takes?

Education: BS or BA degree.
Allowable Substitution: An additional five (5) years of acquisition or logistics management experience may be substituted for a BS or BA degree.
Experience - At least five (5) years of experience in operational logistics support or in-service sustainment of weapon system platforms. Requirements

Help

Conditions of employment

Must be determined suitable for federal employment.

grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector:

Experience assisting with applying standardized rules, procedures, methods, techniques, and operations that apply to radiological principles or health physics.

Experience assisting with applying standardized rules, procedures, methods, techniques, and operations that apply to radiological principles or health physics.
Experience assisting with utilizing radiation survey to implement radiation control requirements in assigned ship or shipyard area(s).
Experience utilizing ship and shipyard layout (including location of safety and emergency equipment, drain water and sewage systems, harbor, contaminated equipment, and radiation sources) to plan ways to control possible incidents.

Education

Specialized Experience (for Positions At GS-4 And Above)

Examples of qualifying specialized experience include work in the fields of astronomy, physics, geophysics, chemistry, hydrology, health physics, engineering, electronics, geology, oceanography, and metallurgy.

Experience as a laboratory mechanic or in a trade or craft may be credited as general or specialized experience when the work was performed in close association with physical scientists or other technical personnel and provided intensive knowledge of appropriate scientific principles, methods, techniques, and precedents.

Gs-06

Graduate education or an internship meets the specialized experience required above GS-5 ONLY
in those instances where it is directly related to the work of the position.

Successful completion of a full 4-year course of study leading to a bachelor's degree (a) with major study in an appropriate field of physical science, or (b) that included at least 24 semester hours in any combination of courses such as physical science, engineering, or any branch of mathematics, except financial and commercial mathematics.

Successful completion of 2 years of study that included at least 12 semester hours in any combination of courses such as physical science, engineering, or any branch of mathematics, except financial and commercial mathematics.

Equivalent combinations of education and experience may be combined to meet the total qualification requirements.

. See OPM's General Policies for information on crediting education.

The Network Coordinator plays a vital role in supporting the City’s enterprise network program. This position is instrumental in maintaining secure, resilient, and modern network services, which are essential for the seamless operation of City functions and furthering the objectives set forth in the City’s IT Strategic Plan.

Reporting Structure:
Reporting directly to the Enterprise Network Manager, the Network Coordinator assists with daily network operations, ensuring that the City’s network infrastructure functions reliably and efficiently.

Core Responsibilities:
The Network Coordinator is responsible for coordinating technical projects and supporting improvements in policy and processes. These efforts are aimed at enhancing service delivery, strengthening business continuity, and promoting standardization across various City departments.

Collaboration and Liaison:
Acting as a key liaison, the Network Coordinator facilitates communication and coordination among City departments, engineering teams, and third-party vendors. The position ensures that network-related issues are escalated and resolved efficiently, thereby maintaining reliable and accessible network services throughout the organization.

Strategic Alignment:
The Network Coordinator ensures that all network activities are consistently aligned with the City’s strategic priorities, including innovation, security, transparency, operational value, and a citywide perspective.

Key Areas Of Responsibility

Assist with network operations and support.
Develop, implement and maintain network policies, processes, and procedures.
Manage Citywide and department-specific network projects.
Coordinate City departments, IT management, Subject Matter Experts and other stakeholders to provide network services.
Work with other IT groups and City departments to promote the enterprise network strategy as well as the supporting architecture, implementation, and security requirements.
Practice network asset management, including maintenance of network component inventory, life cycle management and related documentation.
Review, conduct research, and make recommendations for improvements within the City's network program.
Regularly evaluate and stay abreast of the latest network technologies and principles
Serve as an escalation point for network-related issues, ensuring that complex, high-impact, or unresolved problems are routed appropriately to engineering teams, vendors, or management.
Monitor the network for performance, fault and security issues and respond accordingly.
Support network infrastructure planning design and implementation activities.
Oversee MACD, network equipment installation and configuration and other site provisioning services.
Coordinate site surveys and work with customers to gather and translate business needs into technical requirements.
Manage third party vendor(s) to properly deliver network services.
Work both independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment with tight time constraints.
Respond to network issues or questions in a professional and timely manner.

Minimum Requirements

Minimum of four (4) years of experience in network operations and support.
Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple tasks, timelines, and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
Clear understanding of network infrastructure and services including firewall management, DMZ, network circuits, WAN/LAN, DNS, DHCP, VPN, monitoring, wiring and cabling, and wireless infrastructure.
Knowledge of telecom infrastructure including network data circuits, digital communication systems, cabling and network topology.
Understanding of contact center operations, telecom expense management, cloud fundamentals, and security concepts.
Ability to work with and manage vendors including:

Overseeing and coordination with vendors on an operational level.
Holding vendors accountable to contractual obligations, service levels, and agreed-upon deliverables.
Navigating multi-vendor environments by facilitating communication, clarifying responsibilities, and ensuring vendors collaborate effectively to support ongoing network operations and project deliverables.
Ability to translate business needs into actionable technical requirements.
Skilled at explaining technical concepts to both technical and non-technical staff with the ability to articulate how it relates to and impacts the “big picture”.
Ability to communicate clearly and succinctly in a way that avoids confusion, builds alignment, and drives timely action across diverse audiences.
Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to proactively identify problems and support creative and viable technology solutions.
Demonstrated ability to exercise thoughtful, deliberate judgement in fast-moving, high intensity operational environments, with a strong awareness of how decisions impact colleagues, stakeholders, and City operations.
Strong quantitative analytical abilities, including a thorough understanding of common data analysis tools and programs.
Hands-on experience with ISP coordination, MACD tasks, and site provisioning in operational network environments (preferred).
Experience developing or maintaining IT documentation, diagrams, or standard operating procedures.
Understanding of change management fundamentals, including risk/impact analysis, scheduling of technical work, and communication to relevant stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-departmental technical projects by anticipating and mitigating risks, identifying and removing barriers, and driving timely, policy-aligned solutions in collaboration with diverse stakeholders.
Ability to drive technical innovation and cost-effective solutions for the City network technologies.
Experience development and documenting training are necessary to use network services as well as documenting the roles and call escalations for supervisors.

Desirable Qualifications:
The ideal candidate will possess the following qualifications:

Excellent interpersonal, customer service, and communication skills, with the ability to tailor messages appropriately to diverse audiences, including City leadership, elected officials, and community stakeholders.
Experience developing disaster recovery plans along with standard operating procedures for planned outages and redundancy.
Interest in municipal activities and services and how they impact the community.
Highly ethical and objective, with the ability to navigate in a political environment without being political.
Energetic and motivated with the ability and desire to take initiative.

The Department

The Department of Information Technology (IT), with a vision of delivering superior technology and wireless services, aims to foster strategic innovation through active collaboration with City and regional stakeholders. It provides enterprise IT services to the City of San Diego, its departments, locations, employees, and residents. The department includes ten teams working in key areas, including Wireless Technology Services, IT Contracts Management Team, Architecture and Engineering Team, and Cyber-Security and Risk Management Team. Through its mission of driving forward-thinking technology initiatives, IT seeks to provide high-quality services that meet the City's current needs. For more information, please visit this link.

The City

With more than 1.4 million residents, the City of San Diego is the eighth largest city in the United States and the second largest in California. The City of San Diego’s strong economy, diverse population, great educational institutions, unsurpassed quality of life, and world-renowned location make it the ideal place to work, live, and play. With its great weather, miles of sandy beaches, and major attractions, San Diego has something to offer for everyone.

The City’s Mission, as stated in the Strategic Plan is “Every day we serve our communities to make San Diego not just a fine city, but a great City.” The City’s Vision is "Opportunity in every neighborhood, excellent service for every San Diegan".

As one of the region’s largest employers, the City of San Diego employs nearly 13,000 highly dedicated employees and has a combined Fiscal Year 2027 operating and capital budget of approximately $6.42 billion. Additional information about the City of San Diego can be found on the City’s website.

A wide variety of cafeteria-style health and wellness plans or in-lieu cash waiver.
11 paid City holidays per calendar year and 1 floating holiday per fiscal year.

Free transit pass (including MTS Trolley, MTS Bus, and all Rapid and Rapid Express bus services).
Access to premier City golf courses at a discounted rate.

City-paid life insurance.
